title: A zero is not a dead end
hook: A zero is not a dead end. Follow the computed steps.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Arithmetic, function evaluation, vector dot products, small matrices and solving linear equations.
doesNotKnow: Swap in a nonzero or larger pivot before elimination rather than dividing by a zero or tiny diagonal.

misconception: A zero diagonal means the linear system has no solution.
objective: Swap in a nonzero or larger pivot before elimination rather than dividing by a zero or tiny diagonal.

claims.text: A row exchange places a usable pivot on the diagonal without changing the solution set. Elimination then avoids zero division; the contrasting tiny pivot also motivates choosing the larger available entry.
